# 特征值和特征向量

```{python}
from sympy import Matrix, pprint
from IPython.display import display

A = Matrix([
    [0.8, 0.3],
    [0.2, 0.7],
])

display(A**2, A**3, A**100)
```

例 6.1

```{python}
from sympy import Matrix
from IPython.display import display
import sympy as sp

lam = sp.symbols("lambda")

A = sp.Matrix([
    [sp.Rational(4, 5), sp.Rational(-3, 10)],
    [sp.Rational(-1, 5), sp.Rational(7, 10)],
])

expr = (A - lam * sp.eye(2)).det()

display(expr)
display(sp.factor(expr))

display((A - lam * sp.eye(2)).det())  # 按定义算 det(A-λI)
display(A.charpoly(lam))  # 直接求特征多项式
display(A.eigenvals())  # 直接求特征值；代数重数
display(A.eigenvects())  # 直接求特征值；代数重数；特征向量
```
